reference_components: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W official 65 x 30 mm board and 58 x 23 mm mounting pattern
two Feetech SCS0009 manufacturer envelopes; supplied horn interface remains provisional
25 x 24 mm OV5647-family Pi Zero camera reservation; supplier revision must be measured
GY-521 IMU reservation; supplier revision must be selected and measured
external regulated 5 V tether for Rev A; no battery is enclosed
provenance: Original Ariad geometry. GrowBot inspired the two-servo architecture; no GrowBot mesh or dimensions were imported.
claim_boundary: Component-first Rev A prototype geometry for a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W and two SCS0009 servo envelopes. The Pi board outline and mounting pattern and servo body envelope are manufacturer-sourced; camera-module variation, servo horn fit, generic FDM clearances, repeated snap life, balance, strength, gait, thermal behavior, electrical integration, and physical operation remain unverified.
